name: worktrees
description: Parallel Claude sessions in git worktrees: safe sync to origin's main branch, env-file links, a guard against writing into the main checkout, and a /worktree status skill.

detect.ask: Do you run parallel Claude sessions in git worktrees?

facts.name: WORKTREE_DIR
facts.meaning: Where session worktrees live, relative to the main checkout. Default `.claude/worktrees` (where `claude --worktree` and EnterWorktree create them).
facts.ask: Where do your session worktrees live, relative to the repo root? Press enter for `.claude/worktrees`, where Claude Code creates them.

facts.name: WORKTREE_ENV_FILES
facts.meaning: Untracked env files to symlink from the main checkout into each new worktree (comma-separated paths from the repo root), or `none`. Links are made only where the file is missing; nothing is overwritten.
facts.ask: Which untracked env files should each worktree link to from the main checkout? Comma-separated paths from the repo root, or `none`.
